# Captured Lava regression evidence

Each JSON contains the actual first-party listing entry and unchanged
`view_details_specs` string projected from the accepted recon response.
`provenance.json` records original URL, UTC capture time and full-response
SHA-256. The projection removes unrelated page content; no spec HTML is
rewritten. Captures cover eleven current products, including four previously
zero-field attribute-bearing tables. Nested comment openers are preserved
as source evidence; obsolete comment content must not become current specs.
